report_name: South Korean Financial Sector Hit by Coordinated Cyberattacks

attack_patterns.name: Exploit Public-Facing Application
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exploited vulnerabilities in ancillary, internet-connected systems, such as websites for loan agents and mobile work-support platforms, to bypass core banking systems.

attack_patterns.name: Vulnerability Scanning
attack_patterns.description: Attackers likely used automated scanners to identify vulnerabilities in web applications associated with the banks, indicated by distributed attack traffic from multiple countries.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Information Repositories
attack_patterns.description: After gaining a foothold, attackers performed discovery to identify and collect data from databases containing customer or employee information.

attack_patterns.name: Exfiltration Over C2 Channel
attack_patterns.description: Attackers exfiltrated sensitive data such as names, resident registration numbers, and financial details from compromised systems.

tools.name: Artificial Intelligence
tools.description: South Korean authorities suspect that attackers may have leveraged Artificial Intelligence (AI) for automating vulnerability discovery, optimizing attack paths, or crafting more effective exploits.

campaigns.name: October 2026 South Korean Financial Sector Attacks
campaigns.description: A widespread and coordinated cyber campaign in October 2026 targeting multiple South Korean financial institutions by exploiting externally-facing web applications to breach customer and employee data.

identities.name: Shinhan Bank
identities.description: A major South Korean bank targeted in the attack, resulting in the exposure of 25,727 records including names, phone numbers, and loan information.

identities.name: KB Kookmin Bank
identities.description: A major South Korean bank targeted in the attack, resulting in the leak of 119 customers' personal and credit information.

identities.name: Hana Bank
identities.description: A major South Korean bank targeted in the attack, resulting in the exposure of 89 customers' data, including resident registration numbers.

identities.name: Woori Bank
identities.description: A major South Korean bank listed as one of the affected institutions in the coordinated cyberattacks.

identities.name: Yegaram Savings Bank
identities.description: A South Korean savings bank targeted in the attack, resulting in the exposure of 40,000 customers' data.

infrastructure.name: Attacker Scanning Infrastructure
infrastructure.description: Distributed infrastructure with IPs traced to the US, Japan, Singapore, Vietnam, and Britain, used for broadly scanning for vulnerable systems in the South Korean financial sector.

indicators.name: Suspicious Loan Agent or Mobile Support URL Access
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Loan Agent or Mobile Support URL Access
id: 2b8a1c9e-7f5d-4b3a-8e1f-9c0d2a4b6e8d
status: experimental
description: Detects access to URL paths commonly associated with ancillary financial applications like loan agent or mobile support portals, which were targeted in recent attacks.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-04
references:
  - https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/opinion/ai-hacking-spree-exposes-cracks-in-financial-sector-security/12904304
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: medium
logsource:
  category: proxy
detection:
  selection:
    c-uri|contains:
      - '/loan_agent/'
      - '/mobile_support/'
      - '/agent-portal/'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects web traffic to ancillary application paths such as '/loan_agent/' or '/mobile_support/', which were identified as initial access vectors.

indicators.name: Suspicious Child Process of Web Server
indicators.pattern:
title: Suspicious Child Process of Web Server
id: 8d3e4f5a-6b7c-4d9e-8f1a-2b3c4d5e6f7a
status: experimental
description: Detects unusual child processes spawned by common web server processes, which could indicate code execution from a compromised web application.
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-10-04
references:
  - https://www.koreajoongangdaily.com/opinion/ai-hacking-spree-exposes-cracks-in-financial-sector-security/12904304
tags:
  - attack.t1190
level: high
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\w3wp.exe'
      - '\httpd.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\sh.exe'
      - '\bash.exe'
      - '\whoami.exe'
      - '\net.exe'
  filter_known_legit:
    CommandLine:
      - 'C:\Windows\System32\inetsrv\w3wp.exe -ap "DefaultAppPool" -v "v4.0" -l "webengine4.dll" -a \\.\pipe\iisipm1a2b3c4d -h "C:\inetpub\temp\apppools\DefaultAppPool\DefaultAppPool.config" -w "" -m 0 -t 20'
  condition: all of selection_* and not filter_known_legit
indicators.description: Detects web server processes (e.g., w3wp.exe, httpd) spawning unusual child processes, indicating potential remote code execution via a web shell.
